keyFindings.description: listPullRequests reads only PRs updated since `since`; a PR open through the window with no update in it is missing from a run made at the window's end but counted by a later run once anything touches it, and the Python before run counted every open PR. The README's claim (65) that a late run counts the same PRs as one made as the window ended does not hold for it. Union the list with the open PRs.
A merge with an unfetchable parent is recorded kind forward (40-53) without an ancestry check; README 15-23 defines forward by ancestry. Say so in the README.
readRawRun (116-131) does not check createdAt/mergedAt, which existedInWindow now reads; a record without createdAt silently drops out of a selection run.
